description.value: Barley Mill Brew Pub is a Penticton institution operating since 1982 in a distinctive Tudor-style building, with its own craft brewery producing house beers since 1997. The pub offers both indoor seating and a misted outdoor patio designed for hot Okanagan afternoons, plus a family-friendly upstairs bistro. Touring cyclists will find a full hearty menu spanning wings and flatbreads to steaks and ribs, alongside a lineup of in-house craft ales.

address.value: 2460 Skaha Lake Rd, Penticton, BC V2A 6E9
